title: The lean years: royalties and friends
summary: She had few jobs and survived on royalties and friends like Dizzy and Lorraine.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: There's a sort of a gap between your talking about the night that the President was assassinated back in 1963. This was about 7 years later. What happened in between...?
Well I was trying to record. That's when I did St. Martin de Porres when that great saint was canonized. That was '62 or '63. I would get gigs now and then.

Dizzy would book me - not book me but he'd recommend me for various places. I don't guess I had over 3 or 4 jobs a year. But the strangest thing happened. I think I received more royalties than I ever received, I don't know why. I had no money coming in but it came in through friends, Lorraine, Dizzy, or royalties. Maybe somebody had sold - let's see, how much do you get, about 6 or 7 hundred dollars per (.) It goes up and down for things like that. I didn't have too much but I believe if you give away - during that period I was so stupid. I've always been like that; I'd give away my last penny and seemed like I'd find 4 times more, as much or something. I didn't have many jobs. I don't know how I existed but I did. I existed enough to help others.
So when you weren't actually working on a job, you no longer had the Bel Canto store. What were you doing during the interim?
